quests.instruction: The classroom is cool, but the playground is sunny and warm. Which clothing helps Lina most during the day?
quests.correctAnswer: A zip-up sweater she can take off 🧶
options: A thick snow jacket she wears all day 🧥
A rain poncho she keeps on indoors 🌧️
A zip-up sweater she can take off 🧶
quests.hint: She needs to adjust as the temperature changes.
quests.explanation: A zip-up sweater can be worn in the cool classroom and removed outside.
quests.funFact: Writing your name inside clothes helps lost items find their way back.

quests.instruction: It's art day at school. Which clothing choice is most practical for Sana?
quests.correctAnswer: Clothes she doesn't mind getting paint on 🎨
options: Her best party outfit 🎉
A scarf with long dangling ends 🧣
Clothes she doesn't mind getting paint on 🎨
quests.hint: Art can get messy.
quests.explanation: Choosing clothes that can get messy means you can paint freely without worrying.
quests.funFact: Smocks and aprons also help protect clothes during art class.

quests.instruction: Mei's class will walk two kilometers on a field trip. Which footwear is the wise choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Comfortable closed shoes 👟
options: Shiny dress shoes 👞
Comfortable closed shoes 👟
Backless slides 🩴
quests.hint: Focus on walking a long way.
quests.explanation: Closed shoes that fit well support your feet and stay on during a long walk.
quests.funFact: Shoes that rub for a long walk can cause blisters.

quests.instruction: Which outfit is safest for climbing a playground frame?
quests.correctAnswer: Fitted pants and closed shoes 🧗
options: Socks without shoes 🧦
A jacket with long dangling cords 🧥
Fitted pants and closed shoes 🧗
quests.hint: Look for what could catch on equipment or slip.
quests.explanation: Close-fitting clothes and shoes with grip lower the chance of getting caught or slipping.
quests.funFact: Many playgrounds ask children to remove scarves and long cords before climbing.

quests.instruction: It is a hot, sunny day and Kofi wants to use a metal slide. What helps protect the backs of his legs?
quests.correctAnswer: Pants or longer shorts 👖
options: A sun hat and sunglasses 👒
Pants or longer shorts 👖
Short shorts and bare legs 🩳
quests.hint: The slide touches his legs.
quests.explanation: Metal can get very hot in the sun, and fabric between your skin and the slide helps.
quests.funFact: Slides in full sun can be hot enough to burn skin.

quests.instruction: A drawstring on Priya's jacket hangs near the swing chains. What should she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tuck it in or remove it so it can't catch 🪢
options: Tuck it in or remove it so it can't catch 🪢
Tie the ends together around the chain 🔗
Leave it hanging loose so it can swing 🤷
quests.hint: Think about what could get caught.
quests.explanation: Dangling cords can catch on playground equipment, so keeping them tucked in is safer.
quests.funFact: Many children's jackets have no drawstrings for this reason.

quests.instruction: Zoya's bedroom gets very cold at night and her pajamas are thin. What helps her stay warm?
quests.correctAnswer: Long-sleeved pajamas and warm socks 🧦
options: Sleeping in damp clothes 💦
Long-sleeved pajamas and warm socks 🧦
Short pajamas with the window open 🪟
quests.hint: Cover more of the body.
quests.explanation: Long sleeves, long pants, and socks hold warmth close to the body overnight.
quests.funFact: Cold bedrooms are warmer with layers, not with damp clothing.

quests.instruction: Why is it safer to sleep in pajamas without long cords or strings?
quests.correctAnswer: Strings can tangle or catch ⚠️
options: Cords stop pajamas drying 💧
Cords make pajamas shrink 📉
Strings can tangle or catch ⚠️
quests.hint: Think about moving in the night.
quests.explanation: Long strings can wrap around the neck or catch on bedding, so safe pajamas avoid them.
quests.funFact: Children's sleepwear often has special safety rules.

quests.instruction: Zoya's pajama pants are so long that they bunch around her feet. Why could that be a problem when she gets up at night?
quests.correctAnswer: She could trip on them in the dark 🌙
options: They might shrink during the night 📉
They might get too warm for sleeping 🔥
She could trip on them in the dark 🌙
quests.hint: Think about walking in a dark room.
quests.explanation: Pants that are too long can catch under your feet and make you trip. Rolling them up or choosing the right size helps.
quests.funFact: Pajama cuffs can be folded up once or twice until a child grows into them.

quests.instruction: Aisha has a ten-minute walk in heavy rain. Which plan keeps her driest?
quests.correctAnswer: Raincoat with a hood, rain boots, and an umbrella ☔
options: Raincoat with a hood, rain boots, and an umbrella ☔
Cotton hoodie, canvas sneakers, and a cap 👟
Light cardigan, sandals, and a sun hat 👡
quests.hint: Cover head, body, and feet with waterproof things.
quests.explanation: Waterproof layers from head to toe stop rain from soaking in anywhere.
quests.funFact: Heavy rain can find any gap, so covering all areas matters.

quests.instruction: Which shoe material is the least suitable on a rainy day?
quests.correctAnswer: Suede 👞
options: Suede 👞
Rubber 🥾
Waterproof synthetic 👟
quests.hint: One of these soaks up water and stains.
quests.explanation: Suede is soft leather that soaks up water and can be damaged by rain.
quests.funFact: Suede has a fuzzy surface because the leather is brushed.

quests.instruction: Zoe's raincoat has a hood, but wind keeps blowing it off. Which feature would help most?
quests.correctAnswer: A drawstring or brim to hold the hood snug 🧥
options: Longer sleeves to cover the hands 💪
A bigger pocket to carry an umbrella 👖
A drawstring or brim to hold the hood snug 🧥
quests.hint: The problem is the hood coming off.
quests.explanation: A drawstring tightens the hood around the face so wind can't pull it off.
quests.funFact: Hoods with a stiff brim also keep rain off your eyes.

quests.instruction: Kofi is spending a whole day at the beach. Which combination protects him best from the sun?
quests.correctAnswer: Wide-brim hat, light shirt, and sunscreen on bare skin 🌞
options: Wide-brim hat, light shirt, and sunscreen on bare skin 🌞
Wool sweater, boots, and a woolly hat 🧶
Raincoat, mittens, and a thick scarf 🌧️
quests.hint: Think about shading and covering skin.
quests.explanation: A hat shades his face, a shirt covers his body, and sunscreen protects the skin that is still showing.
quests.funFact: Sunscreen needs to be put on again after swimming or sweating.

quests.instruction: What do sunglasses with UV protection help with?
quests.correctAnswer: Protecting eyes from bright sunlight 🕶️
options: Making the sun feel warmer on skin ☀️
Protecting eyes from bright sunlight 🕶️
Keeping hair from blowing in the wind 🌬️
quests.hint: Consider what the sun does to eyes.
quests.explanation: UV protection reduces glare and shields eyes from harmful sunlight.
quests.funFact: Sunglasses should say they block UV rays.

quests.instruction: Priya puts sunscreen on, wearing a T-shirt and shorts. Which area is easy to forget?
quests.correctAnswer: Ears and the back of her neck 👂
options: Skin inside her shoes 👟
Ears and the back of her neck 👂
Skin under her shirt 👕
quests.hint: Which areas are bare but out of sight?
quests.explanation: Ears and the back of the neck are exposed but easy to miss, and they can sunburn.
quests.funFact: Sunburn can happen even on cloudy days.

quests.instruction: It is below freezing at the bus stop and the bus is ten minutes away. Which outfit is best for Diego?
quests.correctAnswer: Coat, hat, gloves, and boots 🧥
options: Coat, hat, gloves, and boots 🧥
Hoodie, sneakers, and thin gloves 👟
T-shirt, scarf, and a baseball cap 🧣
quests.hint: Cover as many body areas as you can.
quests.explanation: Warm covering for the body, head, hands, and feet keeps heat in while waiting.
quests.funFact: Waiting outside in cold weather cools you faster than walking.

quests.instruction: Yuki's gloves are thin and her fingers feel numb. What would help most?
quests.correctAnswer: Switch to thicker, insulated mittens 🧤
options: Switch to thicker, insulated mittens 🧤
Take the gloves off to let fingers breathe 🙈
Rub her fingers in the cold wind 🌬️
quests.hint: Fingers need more insulation.
quests.explanation: Thicker mittens trap more heat around the fingers.
quests.funFact: Mittens keep the fingers together to share warmth.

quests.instruction: A gap between Mia's coat collar and her chin lets cold air in. What would close it?
quests.correctAnswer: A scarf wrapped around her neck 🧣
options: A pair of sunglasses on her face 🕶️
A belt pulled tight around her coat 🥋
A scarf wrapped around her neck 🧣
quests.hint: The gap is at the neck.
quests.explanation: A scarf fills the gap and stops cold air getting inside the coat.
quests.funFact: Cold air sneaks in through any opening, not only through thin fabric.

quests.instruction: Noor is invited to a family celebration. Which choice shows good thinking about what to wear?
quests.correctAnswer: Neat, comfortable clothes that suit the occasion 🎉
options: Muddy play clothes from the garden 🪣
Neat, comfortable clothes that suit the occasion 🎉
Pajamas and fluffy slippers 🌙
quests.hint: Focus on the event and about comfort.
quests.explanation: Neat clothes that feel good let you enjoy the event and show you care about it.
quests.funFact: Comfort matters even for dressing up, because celebrations can last for hours.

quests.instruction: Kai isn't sure what style of clothes his cousin's celebration needs. What is the best way to find out?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a family member 💬
options: Ask a family member 💬
Guess and hope 🤷
Stay home 🚪
quests.hint: Someone already knows.
quests.explanation: A family member who knows the event can tell you what people usually wear.
quests.funFact: Different families have different traditions for dressing up.

quests.instruction: Why might Aisha choose clothes from her family's culture for a festival?
quests.correctAnswer: They can be a way to celebrate family traditions 🎎
options: They can be a way to celebrate family traditions 🎎
They are the only clothes that keep you warm 🧥
They are required for every festival 📜
quests.hint: Remember what clothes can mean.
quests.explanation: Many people wear traditional clothes to feel connected to their family and community.
quests.funFact: Traditional clothes around the world use many different fabrics, colors, and patterns.

quests.instruction: Ben will sit in a car for five hours. Which clothes make the trip comfortable?
quests.correctAnswer: Soft, loose clothes and easy shoes 🚗
options: Heavy snow gear ❄️
Stiff jeans with a tight belt 👖
Soft, loose clothes and easy shoes 🚗
quests.hint: Think about sitting for a long time.
quests.explanation: Soft, loose clothes don't pinch while you sit, and easy shoes can come off if you want.
quests.funFact: Stopping to stretch also helps on a long trip.

quests.instruction: Mia is packing for a weekend trip where the weather could be sunny or rainy. What is the smartest choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Mix-and-match layers plus a light rain jacket 🧳
options: One heavy winter coat for all weather 🧥
Mix-and-match layers plus a light rain jacket 🧳
Only shorts and T-shirts for sunny days 🩳
quests.hint: She can't be sure of the weather.
quests.explanation: Mixing and matching layers lets her adjust, and a light rain jacket takes little space.
quests.funFact: Choosing clothes in a few colors lets items be mixed more ways.

quests.instruction: The cabin of an airplane often feels chilly. What is smart to keep within reach?
quests.correctAnswer: A light sweater or jacket 🧶
options: A pair of rain boots 🥾
A light sweater or jacket 🧶
A sun hat 👒
quests.hint: Planes use cool, circulated air.
quests.explanation: A light layer in your bag or on your lap can be added if the air feels cool.
quests.funFact: Planes are often cool because the air is circulated and cooled.

quests.instruction: Mei plays soccer. Which pair of items protects her and helps her play?
quests.correctAnswer: Sports shoes with grip and shin guards ⚽
options: Dress shoes and a leather belt 👞
Flip-flops and a woolly winter scarf 🩴
Sports shoes with grip and shin guards ⚽
quests.hint: Grip and protection.
quests.explanation: Sports shoes grip the grass, and shin guards protect the front of the leg from kicks.
quests.funFact: Soccer shoes often have studs for traction on grass.

quests.instruction: Why do many swimmers wear a swim cap?
quests.correctAnswer: To keep hair back and reduce drag 🏊
options: To keep hair back and reduce drag 🏊
To keep their feet warm in the pool 🦶
To keep their goggles from fogging 🥽
quests.hint: Hair floats in water.
quests.explanation: A snug cap holds hair back and helps the swimmer glide through the water.
quests.funFact: Swim caps can also protect hair from pool chemicals.

quests.instruction: A gymnastics coach asks Priya to avoid clothes with loose strings or sharp zippers. Why?
quests.correctAnswer: They can catch on equipment or scratch 🤸
options: They fade quickly in the wash 🧺
They can catch on equipment or scratch 🤸
They look plain next to other clothes ✨
quests.hint: Focus on moving upside down.
quests.explanation: Loose strings can snag on bars and hard zippers can scratch, so smooth, close-fitting clothes are safer.
quests.funFact: Gym clothes are usually made of stretchy fabric that stays close to the body.

quests.instruction: A hot day at sports camp. Which plan works best?
quests.correctAnswer: Light, breathable clothes, a hat, and a full water bottle 💧
options: A fleece top, wool socks, and a scarf 🧦
Light, breathable clothes, a hat, and a full water bottle 💧
A raincoat, rain boots, and an umbrella 🌧️
quests.hint: Think about heat and sweat.
quests.explanation: Light clothes and a hat keep heat down, and water replaces what you sweat out.
quests.funFact: Drinking water before you feel thirsty is a good habit on hot days.

quests.instruction: A school trip includes a museum in the morning and a muddy farm in the afternoon. What is the smartest footwear plan?
quests.correctAnswer: Comfortable shoes plus waterproof boots in the bag 🥾
options: Comfortable shoes plus waterproof boots in the bag 🥾
Smart dress shoes for the whole day 👞
Open sandals for museum and farm 🩴
quests.hint: The ground changes during the day.
quests.explanation: Two types of footwear let you stay comfortable inside and dry in the mud.
quests.funFact: Packing for different places is a skill that helps while traveling.

quests.instruction: Which idea is the best summary of choosing clothes?
quests.correctAnswer: Think about the weather and what you'll be doing 🧠
options: Wear the same outfit every single day 👕
Choose the warmest coat every time 🧥
Think about the weather and what you'll be doing 🧠
quests.hint: Clothes have jobs.
quests.explanation: The best clothes depend on weather, activity, and comfort.
quests.funFact: People who work outdoors, like farmers and sailors, dress for the conditions.
